scope: Source-table comparison and conflict triage; not completed scientific reviews.

primary_source.title: Nutrient requirements for growth of the extreme oligotroph ‘Candidatus Pelagibacter ubique' HTCC1062 on a defined medium
primary_source.locator: Materials and methods, Table 1, Final concentration column
primary_source.interpretation: The AMS1 base table gives magnesium sulfate heptahydrate at 2.8 mM, not the database's generic magnesium sulfate at 28 mM. Calcium is dihydrate in this table, but anhydrous in the database. This is a source/formulation conflict, not authorization to overwrite every AMS1 variant.
